title: BAI Forms New Athletes Committee to Boost Player Representation
indian_angle: This ensures Indian badminton players have a formal voice in the sport's administration and decision-making processes.
summary: The Badminton Association of India announced the formation of its new Athletes Committee, aiming to provide a stronger platform for players' representation and input into the sport's development.

title: Junior World Championships Coaching Camp Underway in Guwahati

indian_angle: This course enhances the skill set of Indian coaches, directly impacting the quality of training available to players nationwide.
summary: The Badminton Association of India successfully conducted its Level-1 (Advanced) Coaches Course across two centers, NCE Guwahati and Raipur, from September 14th to 23rd, 2026, to upskill national coaches.
